en.title: How to buy a Chinese bike in Europe: dealers, direct orders and the real cost
en.description: A practical Europe buying guide covering ten Chinese bike brands, EU and UK import differences, local dealers, owner reports and the questions to ask before paying.
en.intro: A Chinese bike can be a straightforward local-shop purchase or a box that starts its journey on the other side of the world. The important choice is the route: who sells it, where it ships from, and who helps when a small proprietary part stops your riding.

sections.heading: Start with the seller, not the flag on the frame
paragraphs: Compare three routes before opening a currency converter: a local authorized dealer, the brand’s regional warehouse, and a shipment from China. A dealer can quote assembly and help establish fit. Regional stock may reduce transit and customs administration. A direct factory order may offer a configuration or finish that nobody nearby holds.

None of those advantages is automatic. A European-looking website or euro price does not prove that your size is in Europe. Ask for the dispatch country, the legal seller on the invoice and whether the item is physically ready. A frame advertised as available can still need painting.

These ten brands and suppliers are a useful starting shortlist, not a ranking by sales or quality. The linked official routes were checked on September 22, 2026. Use the current directory or shop to find the seller; an old forum contact can be wonderfully helpful and wonderfully out of date.
bullets: [Winspace](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/authorized-dealers): Brand shop or listed dealer; ask which warehouse supplies the exact order.
[Elves](https://elvesbike.com/terms.php): Brand or country distributor; get a paint and production quote.
[YOELEO](https://www.yoeleobike.com/pages/shipping-and-delivery): Global or regional store; warehouse and tax terms depend on the order.
[ICAN](https://icancycling.com/collections/carbon-disc-wheels-usa): Direct shop with selected regional stock; verify the actual SKU.
[LightCarbon](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10): Contact the manufacturer for an itemized frame and shipping quote.
[SEKA](https://www.sekabikes.com/en/seka-global-dealer/): Start with the current global dealer directory.
[Tavelo](https://tavelo.cc/pages/dealer): Brand site and dealer locator; check exact generation and stock.
[PARDUS](https://pardusbicycle.com/dealers/): Check the global dealer network for your country.
[VeloBuild](https://www.velobuild.com/place-order-a0025.html): Website order followed by written configuration confirmation.
[Dengfu](https://m.dengfubikes.com/about/): Direct manufacturer inquiry; confirm model, stock and package.

sections.heading: EU, UK and the rest of Europe need different calculations
paragraphs: For an EU delivery from outside the EU, work from the [European Commission’s online-shopping import guidance](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/customs-procedures-import-and-export/importation/buying-goods-online-coming-non-european-union-country_en). Import VAT, applicable duty and a carrier’s clearance charge are separate questions. The seller’s shipping charge is not necessarily the whole cost of getting the bike through the border.

There is an extra bicycle-specific trap: the EU maintains [anti-dumping measures on certain China-origin bicycles and bicycle parts](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2025/2146/oj/eng). Treatment depends on the goods and applicable exemptions. Do not budget from a generic VAT-only calculator or assume a complete bicycle and a frame receive identical treatment. Get a written landed quote or classification advice for the actual shipment.

The UK has its own [tax and duty rules for goods sent from abroad](https://www.gov.uk/goods-sent-from-abroad/tax-and-duty); Northern Ireland can need separate handling. Switzerland and Norway are not EU members either. A rider’s trouble-free delivery to Switzerland does not establish the import cost of a bike sent to France.

If the seller offers a delivered-duty-paid service, ask who is responsible if the courier requests a further payment, and who is the importer. Keep the answer with the invoice. Marketing that says tax-free is not, by itself, evidence that a legal exemption applies.

sections.heading: What owner stories can actually tell you
paragraphs: In a [2025 ICAN GRARO discussion](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4766.135), one owner reported a roughly four-and-a-half-week arrival after the order came from China because European stock was unavailable. That is a useful question to ask a seller: will this exact order leave the advertised warehouse?

[Elves owners describing orders in 2025 and 2026](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,4032.165.html) reported very different waits, including around a month and ten weeks before dispatch. Their stories support leaving room for production uncertainty; they cannot give you a reliable delivery percentile.

Read the last update, identify the country, and distinguish ordered, dispatched and delivered. A satisfied rider with a completed build tells you something different from a buyer waiting for a tracking number. Neither is a controlled test of every frame that brand makes.

sections.heading: Put a price on having someone nearby
paragraphs: Request two comparable quotes: the same frame generation, the same cockpit dimensions and the same completed build. Add assembly, any fit changes, missing small parts and payment conversion costs. A local bike that costs more at checkout may be closer to the direct build’s finished cost than its bare-frame price suggests.

PARDUS is a good reason to check the dealer route first: its [global directory](https://pardusbicycle.com/dealers/) lists European dealers. That does not guarantee stock of the exact Chinese-market build you found. Match the model year and component list, rather than translating the model name and hoping.

Ask where a warranty claim is handled, whether a replacement frame requires international shipping, and who pays to move the components. Also price a spare hanger and confirm how to order the headset parts. The least glamorous pieces can determine whether your bike misses one weekend or several.

sections.heading: Send one clear message before paying
paragraphs: Use a message like this: Please quote this model, generation, size, finish and cockpit for delivery to my country and postcode. Confirm the dispatch warehouse, included parts, total payable, treatment of import charges, dispatch estimate, cancellation conditions and warranty contact.

Keep the reply and checkout configuration together. If the answers leave a major cost or fit issue unresolved, pause that purchase and compare another route. A good deal should survive a complete spreadsheet—and still leave you excited to ride.

zh-Hans.title: 在欧洲怎么买中国品牌自行车：经销商、直购与落地成本
zh-Hans.description: 涵盖十个中国自行车品牌的欧洲购车指南：当地经销、跨境直购、欧盟与英国进口差异、车主经历，以及付款前要问的问题。
zh-Hans.intro: 买中国品牌自行车，既可以去附近车店，也可能要等一只跨越半个地球的纸箱。先选对购买路径：谁卖给你、从哪里发货，以及一颗专用小零件让你停骑时，该找谁。

sections.heading: 先确认卖家，再看车架上的品牌
paragraphs: 打开汇率换算器之前，先比较三种路径：当地授权经销商、品牌区域仓，以及从中国发货。经销商可以把装配和合身建议一起报价；区域库存可能减少运输与清关环节；厂家直购则可能提供当地买不到的配置或涂装。
这些优势都要核实。网页像欧洲网站、标价使用欧元，不代表你的尺码就在欧洲。问清发货国家、发票上的销售主体，以及商品是否已经可以发走。“有货”的车架仍可能等待喷漆。
下面十个品牌与供应商适合用作起点，并非销量或质量排名。官方购买路径核查于 2026 年 9 月 22 日。优先用当前官网名单找卖家；老论坛联系人可能很有用，也可能已经过时。
bullets: [Winspace](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/authorized-dealers): 品牌商城或名单内经销商；确认具体订单的发货仓。
[Elves](https://elvesbike.com/terms.php): 品牌或当地代理；核对涂装与生产报价。
[YOELEO](https://www.yoeleobike.com/pages/shipping-and-delivery): 全球或区域商城；仓库与税费条件须按订单确认。
[ICAN](https://icancycling.com/collections/carbon-disc-wheels-usa): 品牌直购，部分产品有区域库存；核对具体货号。
[LightCarbon](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10): 联系厂家，取得逐项车架及运费报价。
[SEKA](https://www.sekabikes.com/en/seka-global-dealer/): 从当前全球经销商名单开始。
[Tavelo](https://tavelo.cc/pages/dealer): 品牌官网与经销商查询；核对代际和库存。
[PARDUS](https://pardusbicycle.com/dealers/): 先查全球经销网络是否覆盖所在国家。
[VeloBuild](https://www.velobuild.com/place-order-a0025.html): 网站下单后，书面确认完整配置。
[Dengfu](https://m.dengfubikes.com/about/): 直接向厂家询价；确认车型、库存和套餐。

sections.heading: 欧盟、英国及其他欧洲国家要分开计算
paragraphs: 从欧盟以外发往欧盟时，先看[欧盟委员会的网购进口说明](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/customs-procedures-import-and-export/importation/buying-goods-online-coming-non-european-union-country_en)。进口增值税、适用关税和承运商清关服务费是不同项目。卖家收取的运费未必就是货物跨境的全部成本。
自行车还有一个容易遗漏的特殊点：欧盟对部分中国原产自行车及零件维持[反倾销措施](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2025/2146/oj/eng)。实际处理取决于商品及适用豁免，不能只用通用增值税计算器，也不能假设整车与车架的税务处理相同。应针对具体货物取得落地报价或报关分类意见。
英国适用自己的[境外邮寄商品税费规则](https://www.gov.uk/goods-sent-from-abroad/tax-and-duty)，北爱尔兰还可能需要单独处理。瑞士和挪威也不是欧盟成员。一位车友顺利收到瑞士包裹，不能证明法国订单的进口成本。
卖家提供完税交货服务时，要问：若快递再收钱，由谁承担？谁是进口主体？把答复与发票一起保存。“免税”宣传本身不能证明法定免税成立。

sections.heading: 车主故事究竟能说明什么
paragraphs: 在 [2025 年 ICAN GRARO 讨论](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4766.135)中，一位车主表示欧洲缺货后改由中国发货，约四周半收到。这给出一个很实际的问题：我的具体订单，真的会从广告里的仓库发出吗？
[Elves 车主在 2025—2026 年的订单记录](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,4032.165.html)等待时间差异明显，有约一个月，也有十周后才发货。它们说明生产周期需要余量，却不能给出可靠的交货概率。
读到最后一次更新，确认国家，并区分下单、发出与签收。已经装好并满意骑行的车主，和仍在等待单号的买家，提供的是不同证据；两者都不是对整个品牌的全面测试。

sections.heading: 把附近有人能帮忙的价值算进去
paragraphs: 拿到两份可比较报价：相同代际车架、相同把组尺寸、相同完成配置。把装配、合身调整、缺少的小配件及支付换汇费用算进去。结算价较高的本地整车，与直购自组的最终成本，可能没有裸车架标价看起来差那么多。
PARDUS 值得先查经销路线：[全球目录](https://pardusbicycle.com/dealers/)列有欧洲经销商。但这不保证对方有你在中国网站看到的同一配置。应核对年份与部件清单，不能只翻译车型名称。
问清保修在哪里处理、更换车架是否需要跨国运送、移装配件工时由谁承担。另询备用尾钩价格和碗组配件购买方式。最不起眼的小零件，有时决定停骑一个周末还是好几个。

sections.heading: 付款前，把问题一次问清
paragraphs: 可以这样询价：请为这个车型、代际、尺码、颜色和把组，报价发往我的国家及邮编。请确认发货仓、包含部件、总支付额、进口费用处理、预计发货日、取消条件和保修联系人。
把答复与结算配置一起保存。若关键费用或合身问题仍未解决，先暂停该订单，再比较其他渠道。真正合适的交易应当经得起完整预算表的检查，同时仍让人期待骑车。
